title: Individual income reconciliation
html:
Individual income reconciliation

Prepare an income summary using the classifications and assumptions supplied.

Required responses

metadata.taxLawPeriod: 2026; exercise-specific rates and limits are stated in each case

fields.label: Consulting income on digital-asset receipt
fields.explanation: Use fair value of the assets when received for services.

fields.label: Gain on the later digital-asset sale
Total income included under the supplied assumptions
fields.explanation: $93,000 + $4,000 + $1,500 = $98,500; the stated gift and qualifying municipal interest are excluded.

exhibits.title: Receipts
exhibits.html: Wages $90,000; taxable bank interest $3,000; qualifying municipal interest $2,000; genuine cash gift $15,000. Digital assets worth $4,000 were received for taxable consulting services.

exhibits.title: Later sale
exhibits.html: Those digital assets were later sold for $5,500 with no fees. Include the service income and later gain; ignore deductions and special rates.

explanation:
Taxable wages and bank interest

$90,000 + $3,000 = $93,000.

Consulting income on digital-asset receipt

Use fair value of the assets when received for services.

Gain on the later digital-asset sale

$5,500 proceeds less $4,000 basis = $1,500.

Total income included under the supplied assumptions

$93,000 + $4,000 + $1,500 = $98,500; the stated gift and qualifying municipal interest are excluded.
